request: Analyze GSE304351 for PMID 41383117 (NAD(+) Enhanced Mesenchymal Stromal Cells Effect on Muscle Atrophy by Improving SIRT1-Mediated Mitochondrial Function via NAMPT.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina NovaSeq X Plus), mouse quadriceps
final.sample_inclusion: QUAD muscle of D-gal-treated male C57BL/6J mice injected with PBS or MSCs, n = 4 per arm (S3.2.p1, FIG2 legend, Figure S3 legend)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of intramuscular MSC injection vs PBS on quadriceps gene expression in D-galactose-induced muscle atrophy (S3.2.p1). Not an exercise effect: treadmill running is only an outcome test given to all mice (S2.4.p1).
planned_contrasts: D-gal+MSCs vs D-gal+PBS, QUAD (S3.2.p1; paper: 960 DEGs, 525 up / 435 down)
NAD+-MSCs vs MSCs, cultured human MSCs (S3.5.p1, FIG5; not deposited in GSE304351)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.7.p1 (DESeq2 named, DEG cutoff not given); S2.16.p1 p < 0.05 refers to GraphPad tests

paper_results.QUAD MSC vs PBS: 960 DEGs (525 up, 435 down); up enriched in fatty-acid degradation, OXPHOS, PPAR

final.exercise_role: Exhaustive treadmill run (S2.4.p1) used once as a performance readout one week after the last injection, in every group; no exercise intervention or exercise-vs-sedentary arm

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Title, abstract (ABS.p2-p3) and methods (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1, S2.7.p1) describe D-gal-induced atrophy treated with MSCs/NAD+-MSCs. The only exercise element is a treadmill endurance test applied to all mice as an outcome measure. RNA-seq of muscle compares D-gal+MSCs with D-gal+PBS (S3.2.p1). DA.p1 names GSE304351 as the RNA-seq deposit.

checks: 8 GSM titles 'the quadriceps of D-gal+PBS/MSCs mice 1-4' match S3.2.p1 and n = 4 in the FIG2/Figure S3 legends
matrix columns PBS1-4/MSC1-4 equal GEO Library names
the MSC +/- NAD+ RNA-seq (FIG5A) is not in this series

ownership.reasoning: Series, sample titles and group sizes match the paper's quadriceps RNA-seq; organism Mus musculus matches.

alignment.reasoning: Deposited matrix columns are '<Library name>_Count'; prep_strip_count_suffix.py drops only the suffix (values unchanged). Key derived from description 'Library name: PBS1'. Group from title.

final.source: GEO data_processing: Hisat2 to GRCm39; 'xlsx file including raw counts for each sample'

matrix.reasoning: All values integers (integer_fraction 1.0), 0 to 4.5e6, column suffix _Count, data_processing states raw counts. 12171 genes (submitter-filtered list).

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the deposited samples differ only by MSC vs PBS injection in D-gal mice. Treadmill running was an outcome test given to all mice (S2.4.p1), not a factor, so the exercise estimand the request asks for is not identifiable.

candidates.reason_rejected: Valid paper contrast but it estimates a cell-therapy effect, not an exercise effect; outside the requested exercise estimand
No such factor: every mouse did the same exhaustive treadmill test and no sedentary/untested arm was sequenced

design.reasoning: Request is how exercise affects gene expression. Paper (S2.3.p1, S2.4.p1, S3.2.p1) has no exercise intervention; the single RNA-seq factor is MSC vs PBS injection. Refused at design.

discrepancies.data: not deposited in GSE304351 (8 quadriceps samples only)
